title: Block Secrets in Prompts
summary: A Claude Code hook that blocks a prompt before it is sent when it holds an AWS, GitHub, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe or Slack key, or a private key block.
description: Pasting a stack trace often drags a live token along with it. This UserPromptSubmit hook scans your message for well-known key shapes and stops it before the model sees anything.
The warning names the kind of secret and never repeats the value. Remove the key, mention it by variable name, and send the prompt again. Everything is checked locally with regular expressions.
useWhen: Paste logs and configs into the chat often
Share a screen or session with other people
Work with cloud keys that cannot be rotated quickly
Add a safety net for a whole team

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const q=String.fromCharCode(34),sq=String.fromCharCode(39),bs=String.fromCharCode(92),nl=String.fromCharCode(10);const t=String(j.prompt||'');const pats=[['an AWS access key',/AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}/],['a GitHub token',/(gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,})/],['an Anthropic or OpenAI key',/sk-(ant-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}/],['a Stripe live key',/[rs]k_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}/],['a Slack token',/xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}/],['a Google API key',/AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}/],['a private key',/-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----/]];const h=pats.find(p=>p[1].test(t));if(h){console.error('Prompt not sent: it contains '+h[0]+'. Remove the secret, refer to it by variable name instead, and send the prompt again.');process.exit(2)}})"

example.prompt: Why does this fail? AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID is set to a key beginning with AKIA followed by sixteen characters.
example.result: The prompt is stopped with a note that it contains an AWS access key. Nothing is sent until you remove it.

faq.question: Does it find every kind of secret?
faq.answer: No. It knows common token formats and PEM private key headers. Passwords, database URLs and custom tokens are not recognized.

faq.question: Is my prompt sent anywhere to be checked?
faq.answer: No. The hook is a local node script reading the prompt from standard input, with no network access.

access: Reads the text of each prompt you submit
Matches it against a fixed list of key patterns
Blocks the prompt on a match; stores and sends nothing
